capabilities.notes: Parser and executor support READ command semantics with script-relative path resolution and diagnostics; Phase B hardening expanded include-path and malformed-include diagnostic regression coverage.

Legacy FUNCTION numbers map deterministically into canonical ScalarField selections shared by script and GUI flows. 2026-04-28: all 48 previously-unimplemented scalar functions (100-199) are now fully implemented — density family (101-104), pressure family (111-119), temperature family (120-124), enthalpy family (130-133), energy family (140-145), velocity/flow family (154-158), entropy family (170-171), vorticity family (180-188), shock/gradient family (190-193). Non-derivative scalars compute in compute_scalar_field; derivative fields (vorticity, divergence, gradients, helicity, shock functions, stream function) compute via compute_scalar_field_with_grid using curvilinear Jacobian-based derivatives. No FUNCTION numbers in 100-199 remain as KnownUnimplemented. 2026-04-28 parity hardening: shock sensor formulas now match capability docs (FUNCTION 190 = |∇p|/p, FUNCTION 191 = FUNCTION 190 masked to local M > 1), derivative scalar sampling paths use grid-aware computation for mesh/slice/range workflows, and planar 2D grids use a stable in-plane Jacobian fallback for physical gradients. 2026-04-30 (Phase E): Non-scalar FUNCTION ranges are now fully catalogued and tracked in PlotState. Grid-diagnostic range (0-99): FUNCTION 0-3 (walls, grids, IBLANK holes, orphan points) and FUNCTION 10-12 (crossing grid line check, tet decomposition checks) map to GridFunction variants. Vector field range (200-299): FUNCTION 200-204, 210-211 (velocity, vorticity, momentum, perturbation velocity, velocity×vorticity, pressure gradient, density gradient) map to VectorField variants. Particle/stream-trace range (300-399): FUNCTION 300-301 (particle traces, vortex lines) map to ParticleFunction variants. Special overlay range (400+): FUNCTION 400-401 (shock/filtered shock by pressure gradient) map to SpecialFunction variants. All recognized non-scalar IDs produce deterministic PlotState mutations (grid_function, vector_field, particle_function, special_function fields) and emit Info diagnostics noting deferred rendering. Unrecognized IDs in each range produce Warning diagnostics. Parity fixture non_scalar_function_ranges covers all four non-scalar ranges deterministically. capability_catalog.md updated to describe all four FUNCTION ranges. 2026-04-28 correctness fix: freestream gamma (γ∞) is now resolved from metadata.gaminf rather than hard-coded to DEFAULT_GAMMA in both RefState::from_solution (Rust) and computeScalarField (TypeScript); all normalized scalar fields (NormalizedPressure, NormalizedStagnationPressure, PitotPressureRatio, LogNormalized*, NormalizedTemperature, NormalizedStagnationTemperature, LogNormalizedTemperature, NormalizedEnthalpy, NormalizedInternalEnergy) use ref_state.gamma for the γ∞ normalization multiplier instead of per-point gamma. get_solution_field_range uses a streaming fast path (no extra Vec allocation) for raw Q-file array fields.
VIEW semantics are implemented through the deterministic legacy-to-Three.js translation layer.

VPOINT camera behavior is implemented and covered by translation-layer and parity regression tests. 2026-05-14: parser now accepts unambiguous /ANGLES qualifier abbreviations (e.g., /ANGLE), spherical conversion maps positive theta to legacy display-down Z for parity with reference views, and custom-VPOINT camera default UP is Z when PLOT/UP is unset.

MINMAX is represented in shared PlotState and exercised through parser/executor and GUI parity flows; Phase B hardening added malformed /INC shorthand and incomplete axis-pair diagnostic coverage. 2026-05-13: parser parity updates implemented `NOX/NOY/NOZ` axis-negation semantics and added legacy triplet support (`min max increment`) for both positional and axis-qualified forms while preserving deterministic min/max override behavior. 2026-05-14: headless renderer now uses MINMAX as a framing window (projected fit bounds) across render modes without clipping geometry, and applies isotropic UV-to-screen scaling to prevent axis squish.

Absolute multi-level contour model (AUTOMATIC/INCREMENT/MANUAL) is implemented with deterministic renderer semantics; Phase B hardening added malformed tuple-arity coverage plus /INCREMENT precedence/default-fallback tests, with parser diagnostic consistency checks across contour modes and continued parser regression maintenance. Legacy terminology alignment (2026-04-02) updated user-facing CONTOURS wording, PR2 added explicit parser diagnostics for legacy /LINEAR and /CUBIC qualifier handling, and PR6 follow-up added explicit no-effect diagnostics for /RANGE and /(NO)ATTRIBUTES qualifiers. 2026-04-23: added ColorLegend contour level tick overlay (resolve_contour_levels IPC extended with field_min/field_max); added AUTOMATIC/INCREMENT/MANUAL headless regression fixtures; fixed marching squares zero-vertex edge case in renderer; restored missing App.tsx grid-dimension helper used by subset/walls labels (stability fix, no capability-scope change). 2026-05-02: parser now recognises LINES/COLOR/SURFACE/GRID/DOTS as positional args on CONTOURS lines (no /prefix required); added in_contours_attr_expected + in_contours_attr_payload continuation states for multi-line interactive-prompt form; is_contours_attribute_token extended to cover LINE/SURFACE/GRID/COLOR without trailing S. 2026-05-13: inline single-line color-sequence payloads (e.g., `CONTOURS 40 LINES MAGENTA RED ...`) are consumed in attribute context without false unknown-argument diagnostics, while slash-qualified forms like `CONTOURS/COLOR 12` preserve numeric count semantics for parity fixtures.

PLOT is the shared commit boundary for deterministic RenderIntent generation across script execution and GUI apply flows; Phase B hardening added executor diagnostic-order and SHOW/commit ordering regression coverage, with continued executor regression maintenance for commit-boundary behavior. Legacy terminology alignment (2026-04-02) updated user-facing and diagnostic PLOT wording without behavior changes.

Range-based WALLS model and GUI controls are implemented with shared PlotState integration. 2026-05-01: Viewer range application now passes backend WALLS to Viewer3D and applies WALLS ranges as effective geometry limits when GUI slicing is off, preserving script-driven wall-only rendering semantics. 2026-05-02: GridSubset extended with WallStyle (WallColor, WallRenderMode); headless renderer uses per-wall color from WallStyle; multi-grid wall-only render path reads all grids.

Range-based SUBSETS model and GUI controls are implemented with shared PlotState integration. 2026-05-02: headless export now renders multi-grid subset scalar surfaces using read_all_q_for_grids + render_multigrid_subsets; triangle fill with z-buffer and marching-squares iso-contour overlay are both implemented; global scalar range computed across all grids.

FSURFACE controls and execution semantics are available in script and GUI paths with bounded MVP behavior documented. Legacy terminology alignment (2026-04-02) clarified divergence wording while preserving current MVP behavior, PR2 added explicit parser diagnostics when legacy FSURFACE axis-property qualifiers are used against the current iso-level + FUNCTION model, PR6 follow-up hardened mixed-qualifier precedence and ignored-argument diagnostics for /NONE and /OFF clear-mode handling, and capability-catalog wording now explicitly reflects the bounded-MVP FSURFACE scope.
TEXT annotations are supported through shared state, parser/executor flow, and GUI controls.

SHOW status output is supported with backend status generation and GUI visibility; Phase B hardening includes commit-boundary tests confirming SHOW-only flows do not emit RenderIntent and SHOW output ordering remains stable across commits. Legacy terminology/status alignment updated SHOW family labels to legacy wording (`CONTOUR`, `SURFACE/CARPET/LINE`) across backend output and parity fixtures.

Parser maps VECTORS qualifiers into deterministic PlotState mutations via SetVectors (scalar function, length scale, and attribute toggles), with validation diagnostics for missing/invalid typed qualifier values. Rendering is available as overlay arrows in the interactive viewer and headless contour snapshots; dedicated GUI controls are still deferred.
capabilities.rationale: Script compatibility and deterministic command replay remain primary; VECTORS now render from script/state, while direct GUI editing controls are deferred to a follow-up parity phase.

capabilities.notes: Parser maps RAKES qualifiers into deterministic PlotState mutations via SetRakes (coordinate mode, add/attribute toggles, read/write path, time mode, max points, scalar function), with diagnostics for missing/invalid typed values. Rendering is now available as rake-line overlays in the interactive viewer and headless contour snapshots; dedicated GUI controls remain deferred.
